tools.name: extract_json
tools.description: Use this when you need to turn unstructured text (emails, invoices, receipts, job posts, listings, bios, support tickets, chat logs) into JSON matching a schema. Send the text plus a JSON Schema or a list of field names; get back data that validates against it. Missing values come back as null, neve

tools.name: extract_json_lite
tools.description: Free, rate-limited demo of extract_json: up to 1000 characters of text and 5 fields (or a small schema). Use this to try the service; use extract_json for real work. Free, rate limited.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Use this when you want the current price, limits and payment details for Extract JSON. Free.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: extract_json · Public sink: extract_json.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: extract_json · Public sink: extract_json

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
